findings.evidence: Lines 207–213 already prove `¬ ∃ f, f.zeroExtend = (1 : Ideal (𝓞 K) → ℂ)`; lines 220–224 merely instantiate that rejection for an arbitrary `f`.
findings.fix: Delete it and derive any pointwise use by applying `not_exists_zeroExtend_eq_one` to the proposed witness (with `Function.const_one`/`rfl` to identify the functions).
findings.issue: `zeroExtend_ne_const_one` is an unnecessary specialization of the stronger existing `not_exists_zeroExtend_eq_one`.

findings.evidence: `mathlib/Mathlib/RingTheory/Ideal/Maps.lean:166` states `(I.comap g).comap f = I.comap (g.comp f)`; lines 255–260 reproduce this calculation with three `Ideal.mem_comap` rewrites.
findings.fix: Use Mathlib's `Ideal.comap_comap`, then prove only that the two `mapRingEquiv` ring homomorphisms agree via `mapRingEquiv_trans_apply`.
findings.issue: `comap_mapRingEquiv_trans` manually re-proves composition of ideal preimages by membership extensionality.

summary: The PR adds one redundant rejection theorem and re-proves generic ideal-comap composition plumbing already supplied by Mathlib.
